rounds.text: {"operations": [{"op": "invertEdge", "consumer": "org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.stat.descriptive", "impl": "org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.stat.descriptive.moment.VectorialCovariance"}], "rationale": "The cycle has only one descriptive->moment edge (MultivariateSummaryStatistics using VectorialCovariance), so inverting it removes that direction entirely, leaving only moment->descriptive edges and breaking the cycle in a single operation."}

{"operations": [{"op": "moveClass", "class": "org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.stat.descriptive.moment.VectorialCovariance", "to": "org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.stat.descriptive"}], "rationale": "Moving the leaf class VectorialCovariance into the descriptive package removes the sole descriptive→moment edge (its only referencer, MultivariateSummaryStatistics, becomes an intra-package dependency) while the moment→descriptive edges remain one-directional, leaving no cycle; moving MultivariateSummaryStatistics instead would fail because SynchronizedMultivariateSummaryStatistics still subclasses it and would recreate the edge."}
